observed: The written description calls No. 15 a frame one-story gambrel-roof cottage.
The perspective shows steep lower slopes, shallower crowns, a projecting front roof over the central porch, shingled gable faces and a brick chimney.

artDecisions.reason: A flared roof envelope encloses the unchanged full-height native upper rooms. The slightly lower front ridge and exaggerated skirt clearances simplify the perspective into reusable planar modules. Pitches and extensions are artist choices, not measured historic dimensions.
artDecisions.verticalGables: Horizontal clapboard on the front and side gable faces, requested by the user; shingles retained on sloped roof planes.

construction.textureCoordinates: Metres along the ridge and true sloped surface length; existing texture bytes unchanged.
construction.valleys: Convex-volume clipping removes roof faces buried inside the other gambrel; no notched height field.
construction.gableFacings: Removable horizontal clapboard veneers and closures with holes matching the three existing gable sash apertures; user art direction overrides the source shingled gable finish.
construction.chimney: Shaft extends below the minimum new roof height under its footprint.

deferred: The centered two-space window remains with the map-editor work requested separately by the user. Existing openings remain unchanged.
integration: Artist prefab contribution. No engine editor tile palette, Nautilus importer, collisions or gameplay changes.
